user_prompt:

A. PR
B. PQ
C. QR
D. QT

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
answer.title: Answer

llm_thinking: Since PT is the median to the hypotenuse of a right triangle, it equals half the hypotenuse, so PT = QT = QR/2, confirming the answer is D since PR = QR/√2 doesn't match.
